races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Academy Hurdle
races.verdict:
In a race where the betting is sure to provide more clues the vote goes the way of Stuart Crawford's GREEN HERITAGE ahead of Lunar Stride.

  1. GREEN HERITAGE (IRE)
  2. LUNAR STRIDE (IRE)
  3. JUARILEO (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook 50,000 Graduation Series Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
APACHE PEAK ran to a decent level in bumpers after chasing home the useful Minella Yoga in a hurdle at Fairyhouse at this time last year and is taken to make a successful return to hurdles. Fiveandahalf is another who switched to bumpers after a promising hurdle debut, in his case winning at Ballinrobe in the spring, and he's feared most ahead of Gordon Elliott's Thinkitdontjinxit.

  1. APACHE PEAK (IRE)
  2. FIVEANDAHALF (IRE)
  3. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THE DOTSKI showed improved form when off the mark at Ballinrobe last month, seeing her race out much more strongly away from heavy ground, and this lightly raced mare can make a winning handicap debut with further progress likely. Fraher Field is feared most after beating 17 rivals on her handicap debut at Listowel despite a 4 lb rise, while Cleopatra's Needle is also respected.

  1. THE DOTSKI (IRE)
  2. FRAHER FIELD (IRE)
  3. CLEOPATRA'S NEEDLE (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WONDERFUL EVERYDAY is progressing nicely over hurdles and carried that improvement into handicaps when third despite meeting trouble at Listowel last time, so she can do better again. Boo Radley deservedly got off the mark at Kilbeggan in September and looks the chief threat to his stablemate with further progress likely. Harpy Eagle is holding his form well and should be on the premises again, along with Avalo.

  1. WONDERFUL EVERYDAY (IRE)
  2. BOO RADLEY (IRE)
  3. HARPY EAGLE (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Novice Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
BUNTING may not have had much to beat on his chase debut but he did it easily and gets the vote over Chanceawetmorning and Emmet Mullins chase newcomer Vitorio Piel in this graded novice.

  1. BUNTING (FR)
  2. CHANCEAWETMORNING (IRE)
  3. VITORIO PIEL (FR)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
GORGEOUS TOM is a consistent sort who shaped well when third in the Galway Plate in July and looks to have found a good opportunity to gain a first chase win since graduating from novice company. Croke Park is a smart performer on his day and feared most, particularly if allowed an easy lead, while Apple’s Of Bresil has taken well to chasing and remains with potential for better still now stepping back up in trip.

  1. GORGEOUS TOM (IRE)
  2. CROKE PARK (IRE)
  3. APPLE'S OF BRESIL (FR)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange (Q.R.) Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
WESTERN MODEL won over hurdles in July before running well when second at Downpatrick last month and is likely better than his third at Sligo suggests 2 weeks ago. He makes plenty of appeal at a course he's gone well at previously. Harbour Highway shaped as if ahead of his mark at Listowel and the drop back in trip rates a plus in a switch of headgear. Aurea Fortuna should be fitter after his recent fourth.

  1. WESTERN MODEL (IRE)
  2. HARBOUR HIGHWAY (IRE)
  3. AUREA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook 50,000 Graduation Series Flat Race
races.verdict:
Quite a few to consider but FRISCO LAD looked a nice prospect when making a winning debut at Limerick this summer and is taken to defy a penalty. Sharbel was a shade unlucky not to win at Navan last time so he's a serious player, while Hilly Filly may well reverse Down Royal form with Hutton Star.

  1. FRISCO LAD (IRE)
  2. SHARBEL (IRE)
  3. HILLY FILLY (IRE)

races.name: Wetherby Racecourse Supporting Spinal Research Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This should be a competitive "match" with both having won last time. Preference is for IN THE TRENCHES, who should have more to offer for Jennie Candlish and can boast a slightly more appealing profile than Start Again.

  1. IN THE TRENCHES
  2. START AGAIN (IRE)

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MAGNETUDE was a different class to these on the level and related to winners in this sphere, he makes plenty of appeal representing a stable sure to have him well prepared for this. Conceding 12 lb to the selection may well prove beyond Royal Sapphire but he can give it a good go in his hat-trick quest.

  1. MAGNETUDE
  2. ROYAL SAPPHIRE (IRE)
  3. ELM CREEK (IRE)

races.name: Over The Rainbow Alison Stretton Birthday Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
EVALUATION turns out off the same mark as when a close second at Kelso recently and is taken to go one place better and deny Virtual Rock the hat-trick. Rebel Tribesman should also be on the premises turned out again quickly after his near miss at Hexham over the weekend.

  1. EVALUATION
  2. VIRTUAL ROCK (IRE)
  3. REBEL TRIBESMAN (IRE)

races.name: Mary Lofthouse Supporting Spinal Research Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SINGAPORE TRIP was well prepared to win at this track on return from a break a year ago and in top form over fences, he can pick up where he left off in the spring. Captain Cool has already had a very productive season and while things will start to get tougher, he can make his presence felt again in another small-field affair.

  1. SINGAPORE TRIP (FR)
  2. CAPTAIN COOL (IRE)
  3. IN THE AIR (FR)

races.name: Bobby Renton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The autumn has been the time to catch JOSH THE BOSS in the past and representing a bang-in-form yard, he could be the way to go on reappearance post breathing operation. Breizh River drops in class and is the obvious threat.

  1. JOSH THE BOSS
  2. BREIZH RIVER (FR)
  3. PARISENCORE (FR)

races.name: Ginetta Clothing British Menswear Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The thriving SEEYAINTHESUNINN is taken to defy the handicapper again and make it 4 wins in his last 5 starts. Scottish Dancer went down only to a progressive sort at Hexham last time and rates a threat. You Did is next on the list under Brian Hughes.

  1. SEEYAINTHESUNINN
  2. SCOTTISH DANCER (IRE)
  3. YOU DID (IRE)

races.name: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CENTURION'S SISTER hardly gave her backers a moment's worry when readily opening her account in a Market Rasen maiden a couple of months back and, still unexposed granted this sort of test, she's fancied to continue the good work back in a handicap with cheekpieces retained. Noonetellsmenothin returns with his stable in good form and is a danger, with Fine Point and Farhh Echo other in-form sorts to consider in a competitive finale.

  1. CENTURION'S SISTER (IRE)
  2. NOONETELLSMENOTHIN (IRE)
  3. FINE POINT (IRE)

races.name: Ethical Packaging Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ROI DU ROUME has a basement mark to exploit in this sphere and had excuses on the back of a serious error when fourth at Perth on his most recent start in September. He likely remains with a bigger effort in his locker, not least now stepping back up in trip and can put his assured fitness to good use. Chase debutants Tell The Tale and My Own Lovely Lee are others to factor in, with Wannabe and The Magus others likely players if ready to roll on their respective returns to action.

  1. ROI DU ROUME (FR)
  2. TELL THE TALE (IRE)
  3. MY OWN LOVELY LEE (IRE)

races.name: JCP Solicitors Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SINNATRA has to concede chunks of weight all round but he sets a good standard here on his achievements over hurdles as a novice, not least his excellent second in Grade 1 company at Aintree during the spring. He's every inch the type to take to chasing and is fancied to prove up to the task. Pourquoi Pas Papa had a really productive first season over hurdles and goes chasing with the Paul Nicholls team among the winners so he's next best, ahead of Light Fandango.

  1. SINNATRA (IRE)
  2. POURQUOI PAS PAPA (FR)
  3. LIGHT FANDANGO (IRE)

races.name: RWK Goodman Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GUARD YOUR DREAMS is on a nice mark, has a very good record fresh and represents a yard in flying form, so he ticks plenty of boxes. Nocte Volatus is next best ahead of Lord Accord.

  1. GUARD YOUR DREAMS
  2. NOCTE VOLATUS
  3. LORD ACCORD (IRE)

races.name: Adept GRP Cabinets Novices' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TUTTI QUANTI will make a chaser and was easily the best of these over hurdles, so should prove hard to beat if ready to go. Fellow chase-debutant George's Lad may emerge as the biggest threat having looked transformed by a breathing operation at Haydock in April.

  1. TUTTI QUANTI (FR)
  2. GEORGE'S LAD (IRE)
  3. CAPTAIN TEAGUE (IRE)

races.name: Adept GRP Cabinets Native River Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This could be the time to catch BALLYCAMUS, who was beaten only by the subsequent Kim Muir winner in this equivalent race at Chepstow on his return last year and won off this mark at Ludlow in December. Ben Solo has more wins in him so rates the main threat with this step up in trip likely to suit, with the thriving King Roly another to consider.

  1. BALLYCAMUS (IRE)
  2. BEN SOLO (IRE)
  3. KING ROLY

races.name: Faucets Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IL EST FRANCAIS looked one with serious problems last season but this former high-class chaser starts off the new campaign on a potentially lenient mark on his first run for the Skeltons. The one-time smart Crebilly has already started his revival so is second choice, with Saint Segal also respected back at a realistic level.

  1. IL EST FRANCAIS (FR)
  2. CREBILLY (IRE)
  3. SAINT SEGAL (FR)

races.name: Enigma Flooring Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GINGERBRED can prove himself well handicapped on the back of a notable yard change. Last year's winner Puddlesinthepark looks the main threat.

  1. GINGERBRED
  2. PUDDLESINTHEPARK (IRE)
  3. YES DAY (IRE)

races.name: 31st Oct Halloween Spooktacular Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The opener can go the way of ENRICHED, who has shown encouragement in her 2 starts so far and looks worth a try over the minimum trip. Representing a yard amongst the winners, she gets the vote ahead of Troublesome Guest who wasn't beaten far in a nursery last time, with Shaniko also in the mix.

  1. ENRICHED
  2. TROUBLESOME GUEST (IRE)
  3. SHANIKO

races.name: EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Making his seasonal/stable debut, LONE WARRIOR was beaten only by a now-useful type at Southwell in May and he could still have more to offer after only the 3 career starts. The 4-y-o is taken to get the better of Ensor Mews, who shaped well on his recent return, while Adamlyi is worth another chance after a break.

  1. LONE WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. ENSOR MEWS (IRE)
  3. ADAMLYI

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SHARED ODYSSEY showed the benefit of his debut effort when runner-up at Salisbury early this month, beaten only by a useful prospect, and he can continue his progress to go one better. A pair of the newcomers could be the main dangers, with Leading Role and Fulcrum both making plenty of appeal on paper.

  1. SHARED ODYSSEY (IRE)
  2. LEADING ROLE
  3. FULCRUM

races.name: Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
KNIGHTS CHARGE ran a cracker when narrowly denied on his handicap bow at Doncaster last month, forced to wait for a gap before quickening, and this lightly-raced colt returns to the C&D where he won in May. Open to further improvement, he looks sure to go well. Heyzoom is another interesting 3-y-o who could bounce back from a flop having shown solid form at Royal Ascot back in June, while Lady Roisia likely has more going for her than her form figures suggest.

  1. KNIGHTS CHARGE (IRE)
  2. HEYZOOM (IRE)
  3. LADY ROISIA

races.name: Colwick Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BELIEVITANDUCAN completed a hat-trick when winning the Northumberland Vase in June and still looks fairly treated so given he's an uncomplicated ride, he's taken to make use of stall 2 and prove too strong for some credible rivals. If the pace is strong enough course specialist Rock N Roll Pinkie is lurking on a very interesting mark so needs a look at potentially long odds, while Green Falcon is the potential improver in the field.

  1. BELIEVITANDUCAN (IRE)
  2. ROCK N ROLL PINKIE
  3. GREEN FALCON

races.name: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ANTON MAUVE showed much-improved form when getting off the mark on handicap debut at Yarmouth 27 days ago, winning with a bit in hand and this lightly-raced gelding is open to further improvement. He's taken to follow up at the expense of class-dropper Mayaada, who boasts a positive jockey booking.

  1. ANTON MAUVE
  2. MAYAADA (IRE)
  3. GUNALT WAVELENGTH

races.name: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ICE CUBE showed improved form when resuming winning ways at Ayr but his sixth there 26 days ago came just a day later, clearly too soon. Fresher now, he's fancied to make amends and prove himself well suited by 1m. Lillie Margot returns to the C&D where she won in June and is feared most, whilst the class-dropping Shadow Run could perform better than his likely odds.

  1. ICE CUBE (IRE)
  2. LILLIE MARGOT
  3. SHADOW RUN (IRE)

races.name: Racedays For 9 Pound At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
LEGENDSOFTHELAND had been in good heart prior to having excuses last time, so he is fancied to leave his latest run behind and resume winning ways. The hat-trick seeking Call Time isn't taken lightly, though, along with Rambuso Creek from his much-reduced mark.

  1. LEGENDSOFTHELAND (IRE)
  2. CALL TIME (IRE)
  3. RAMBUSO CREEK (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HAYATE is the obvious one on the back of his promising Newmarket debut at the end of July. With doubts about Encounter's effectiveness at this trip, the chief threat may come from I Am Royal unless betting speaks strongly in the favour of one of the Clive Cox newcomers.

  1. HAYATE (IRE)
  2. I AM ROYAL (IRE)
  3. ENCOUNTER (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ARCTIC TSAR had so much in hand last time that even a 12 lb rise may not stop him. Noble Prince has looked consistent rather than progressive so far but may still provide the chief threat ahead of Rupert The Brave, who has contested decent maiden/novice events the last twice.

  1. ARCTIC TSAR (IRE)
  2. NOBLE PRINCE
  3. RUPERT THE BRAVE (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GUNFIGHTER notched his fourth all-weather success over C&D last month and with his subsequent third easy to put a line through, John Butler's 5-y-o remains firmly of interest. He gets the nod over Port Road, who found only a couple of well-treated rivals too strong here last month and now drops in class. Of the rest, the returning Hitched could have a say from this sort of mark provided he's ready to roll.

  1. GUNFIGHTER (IRE)
  2. PORT ROAD (USA)
  3. HITCHED (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
PROTECTRIX left previous efforts behind when making a successful handicap debut over C&D 3 weeks ago and with further improvement on the cards, John Butler's filly gets the tentative vote to follow up. Heading up the dangers is Assiri Heights, who also took a step forward switched to a handicap last time, with Mertoun and Kitaro Kich taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. PROTECTRIX (IRE)
  2. ASSIRI HEIGHTS (IRE)
  3. MERTOUN (FR)

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Novice Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Having been sent off a well-backed favourite on debut, KEITHAAR went through the race as if to justify that confidence only to find a fellow debutant too strong. With improvement on the cards, Marco Botti's filly earns the vote to open her account at the expense of You're Sensational, who also shaped well first time up when fifth at Yarmouth last month. Iris Olivia and Speed Nation can fight it out for third.

  1. KEITHAAR (IRE)
  2. YOU'RE SENSATIONAL
  3. IRIS OLIVIA (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
Course winner MARENGO STORM had excuses on account of the underfoot conditions at Goodwood 5 weeks ago and, boasting a positive profile prior to that, he's well worth another chance from a handy draw back on all-weather. Rage of Thunder, Philanthropist and Blue Prince are a trio of others to consider in a solid handicap for the grade.

  1. MARENGO STORM
  2. RAGE OF THUNDER (IRE)
  3. PHILANTHROPIST

races.name: Unibet London Sprint Series Final Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several, but it could be worth chancing FAST TRACK HARRY, who is well treated on early-season all-weather form and Clive Cox's 4-y-o is ideally drawn to attack. Augustus Gloop has got his career firmly back on track lately and looks a big threat along with Art Lover.

  1. FAST TRACK HARRY
  2. AUGUSTUS GLOOP
  3. ART LOVER (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NICATOR showed improved form despite coming from a disadvantageous position the way the race developed when fourth over C&D 2 weeks ago. With fewer miles on the clock than the majority here, he could be worth chancing to confirm the promise of that effort here. Wonder for the in-form James Fanshawe yard and Tryfan head up the dangers, with the consistent Londoner another holding solid each-way claims.

  1. NICATOR (FR)
  2. WONDER
  3. TRYFAN

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
TENISON's latest Epsom third appeals as strong form and she can strike under Billy Loughnane. Fellow 3-y-os Spinney and Thunder Goddess may give her most to think about.

  1. TENISON
  2. SPINNEY
  3. THUNDER GODDESS

races.name: Grand Prix Anjou Bretagne - Fonds Europeen De L'elevage Listed Stakes
Prix De La Pointe Du Hode Handicap
Prix Des Falaises De Craie Handicap
Prix Des Boucles De La Seine Handicap
Grand National Des Amateurs Px De L'unat - Attele
Prix Pmu Le Bon Accueuil-tinqueux - Attele
Prix Des Nouveaux Partenaires Pmu - Attele
